meta_description: Monitor stack freshness, deploy status, code quality, and activity across all your repositories.
hero_title: Know the health of every project — at a glance.
hero_sub: Canary scans your GitHub repos and grades them A–F based on dependencies, CI/CD, deploy status, code quality, and more.
feat_title: Everything you need to monitor project health
feat_sub: Canary replaces your mental checklist with automated, continuous scanning across every dimension that matters.
feat_deps_desc: Multi-ecosystem scanning for Node.js, Python, Flutter, and JVM. Detects outdated majors, security vulnerabilities, and suggests update commands.
feat_ci_desc: Checks for CI/CD pipelines, test frameworks, linting config, TypeScript strict mode, and license presence.
feat_deploy_desc: Monitors Vercel, GitHub Pages, npm, Chrome Web Store, and Zenodo. Instant down detection.
feat_activity_desc: Tracks commit frequency, open PRs, unresolved issues, and contributor count over time.
feat_stack_desc: Tracks Next.js, React, Flutter, Spring Boot, Python, TypeScript, and Node.js versions. Flags EOL runtimes.
feat_docs_desc: Detects README version drift, stale CHANGELOGs, TODO pile-up, and missed data update cycles.
feat_research_desc: Semantic Scholar integration for paper projects. Shows field activity, trending keywords, and recent publications.
feat_vibe_desc: Framework-version-specific gotchas and tips for Claude, Copilot, and other AI coding workflows.
how_step1_desc: Define your projects — repo, stack, deploy target, and category.
how_step2_desc: Canary fetches data from GitHub, npm, PyPI, and more via parallel scanners with circuit breakers.
how_step3_desc: A 100-point scoring algorithm grades each project A–F with context-aware adjustments.
how_step4_desc: Get specific update commands, release notes, and recommendations — not just warnings.
grade_sub: Context-aware scoring with leniency for maintenance and prototype projects.
footer_built: Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
